name: A Lesson to Learn
summary: In Darnassus, Mathrengyl Bearwalker sends young druids to Moonglade to learn the ways of water. There, an elder of the Cenarion Circle guides their first steps toward aquatic form.

sections.title: The Call of the Wild
sections.body: Mathrengyl Bearwalker guides young night elf druids as they practice among Darnassus’s boughs. When an initiate shows a firm bond with nature and is ready for greater responsibility, Mathrengyl sends them to master the waters. Cenarius’s gifts demand focus. To cross the depths without drowning, young druids need the guidance of the Cenarion Circle’s elders.

sections.title: Journey to Nighthaven
sections.body: You leave Darnassus for Moonglade, an ancient sanctuary beneath Mount Hyjal. In Nighthaven, Dendrite Starblaze waits as an elder mentor of the Cenarion Circle. Starblaze judges whether young shapeshifters are ready for the trials that lead to aquatic form. Mastering water takes physical resilience and mental resolve.

faq.q: Who sends me on this quest?
aliases: who gives a lesson to learn
faq.answer: Mathrengyl Bearwalker, a druid trainer in Darnassus’s Cenarion Enclave, sends you once your early druidic training has advanced enough.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this quest?
faq.answer: You begin the path toward aquatic form by traveling to Moonglade for instruction and trials from the elder Dendrite Starblaze.
Dendrite Starblaze lives in Nighthaven, on the northern shores of Lake Elune'ara in Moonglade.

faq.q: How do druids reach Moonglade for this quest?
faq.answer: You can use Teleport: Moonglade to travel directly to the sacred grove, guided by your spiritual attunement.

faq.q: What comes after speaking to Dendrite Starblaze?
faq.answer: After you speak with Dendrite Starblaze, he sends you to the Trial of the Lake. There, your endurance and clarity beneath the water will be tested.

angles.text: As a druid, you reach a milestone in your training and open the way to commune with Cenarius's gifts beneath the waves.
As a kaldorei of Darnassus, you honor tradition by answering the Cenarion Circle’s call in Moonglade and connect with your ancient teachers.
